ground_truth.title: Custom Skincare Sets & MJC Promo Terms
ground_truth.main_content:
US

Receive 20% off your purchase of three (3) to five (5) qualifying skincare products (defined below) to create a custom set (“Custom Skincare Set”) (“Discount”) and receive a free 15ml Milky Jelly Cleanser with your purchase of $40 or more (“Gift”) (after discounts and excluding any taxes, shipping and delivery charges). Discount and Gift will be valid from January 16, 2025 at 7:00 AM Eastern Standard Time (“EST”) to January 20, 2025 at 11:59 PM EST at Glossier retail locations and glossier.com. “Skincare Products” include Cleanser Concentrate, Milky Jelly Cleanser, Milky Jelly Cleansing Bar, Full Orbit, Universal Pro-Retinol, Solution, Super Bounce, Super Glow, Super Pure, Priming Moisturizer, Priming Moisturizer Balance, Priming Moisturizer Rich, After Baume, Invisible Shield, and Futuredew. Discount and Gift are non-transferable, not valid on previous purchases, cannot be combined with other offers, and may not be used toward the purchase of gift cards. Discount and Gift will not be granted, may be revoked, and may not be redeemed for a future purchase if initial transaction is canceled or item(s) are returned. Discount and Gift may be suspended or terminated at any time and may be subject to product restrictions or exclusions. Discount and Gift will be automatically applied at checkout Custom Skincare Sets are limited to one (1) per purchase and must contain unique items to be eligible for the discount. Discount and Gift are subject to all applicable laws and are void where prohibited.
